title: A Protocol for the Ghost
author: Orsen Montrose
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
